prose: Bloomberg, citing National Student Clearinghouse data, reports US computer science enrollment fell more than 12 percent for undergraduates and 10 percent for graduate students this fall, as AI reduces coding jobs. Computer and information science departments saw an exodus of students.
highlights: US undergrad CS enrollment fell 12%+ this fall; grad enrollment down 10%+
National Student Clearinghouse data, reported by Bloomberg
Decline attributed to AI reducing coding jobs
